Data Analyst

Northwind is hiring a Data Analyst in Vancouver to help our customers understand their own data. You will sit between the product and success teams and turn recurring questions into durable reporting.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain dashboards in SQL and Python
  • Partner with customer success on quarterly business reviews
  • Define metrics definitions and keep them documented

What we look for

  • Two or more years working with SQL against a warehouse
  • Comfort with Python for data manipulation and charting
  • Clear written communication, since much of the work is async

We offer a remote-friendly setup, a learning budget, and four weeks of vacation.
